title: Software Problems
drDigitalIntro:
If force-quitting and restarting do not fix an app, the next step is to delete it and reinstall it.
• Deleting an app removes it completely — any bugs or corrupted files go with it.
• Reinstalling downloads a clean, fresh copy. Your documents and photos are not affected.
• Where to reinstall: open App Market and search for the app, then tap Install.
• When to do this: after the app crashes repeatedly, shows unexpected errors after an update, or refuses to open even after a restart.
• After reinstalling, open the app and test it to confirm the problem is gone.

playgroundTask.goal: You deleted and reinstalled a broken app to fix it
playgroundTask.scenario: Browser keeps crashing and needs a fresh install

steps.say: Browser keeps crashing. Open App Market from the dock to manage your apps.
Click My Apps to see your installed apps.
Browser has a problem — click Delete to remove it completely.
Browser is removed. Click Store to find it again.
Find Browser and click Install to reinstall a fresh copy.
All done! Click Browser in the dock to open the fresh install.

drDigitalSuccess: You deleted and reinstalled Browser to fix it! This is the right move when force-quitting does not solve the problem.
drDigitalHint: Open App Market, go to My Apps, delete Browser, switch to Store, install it again, then open it from the dock.
